events.description: 15. NOTICE: The Court preliminarily believes that Purcell is a threshold issue in this case. Accordingly, IT IS ORDERED that on or before 9:00 a.m. on Monday, July 22, 2024, the parties shall file pocket briefs, not to exceed ten (10) pages, on the question of whether Purcell bars the requested injunctive relief before the October election. The parties should address at least in part Singleton v. E. Baton Par. Sch. Bd., 621 F. Supp. 3d 618 (M.D. La. 2022) (deGravelles, J.), and any relevant case law in the Fifth Circuit or Supreme Court that has developed since Singleton.(KDC) (Entered: 07/19/2024)

events.description: 41. ORDER:ORDER: Considering the Amended Complaint (Doc. 39), and pursuant to Middle District of Louisiana Civil Rule 12, IT IS ORDERED that Defendant Nancy Landry's Motion to Dismiss for Failure to State a Claim and for Lack of Subject Matter Jurisdiction (Doc. 37) is DENIED WITHOUT PREJUDICE to Defendant's right to re-urge any arguments made in that motion, if appropriate, in response to Plaintiffs' new complaint. IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that the Plaintiff's Ex Parte Motion for Extension of Time to File Memo in Opposition (Doc. 40) is DENIED as moot. Signed by Judge John W. deGravelles on 09/09/2024. (This is a TEXT ENTRY ONLY. There is no hyperlink or PDF document associated with this entry.) (KDC) (Entered: 09/09/2024)
